manifest.description: Infer missing Rust production seams from test pain such as broad super access, fixture wiring, inline test islands, and concrete dependencies.
when_to_use: tests reveal an intended architecture that production code does not expose
large inline test modules or fixture setup obscure production boundaries
a correction plan may use rust-test-island-extract, rust-trait-from-impl, rust-state-extract, or rust-extract-impl-methods
anti_patterns: do not use for test length alone
do not use for moving tests without a production design gap
do not use on non-Rust targets
